title: Evolutionary Analyses of Visual Opsin Genes in Frogs and Toads
author: Ryan K Schott
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b3yqqpvw
materials: Keep all reagents on ice at all times.

Program the thermocycler for the following program: 95 °C for 00:10:00 94 °C for 00:02:00 REPEAT FOLLOWING 3 steps 35-50 times: 94 °C for 00:00:30 45-50 °C for 00:01:00 *temperature depends on primer 72 °C for 00:02:00 72 °C for 00:02:00 4 °C hold

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Lysis
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for RNA extraction using Buffer RLT and Beta-mercaptoethanol.

substeps.instruction: Transfer sample into a 1.5 mL collection tube.
Pipette off RNALATER.
Add 600 µL Buffer RLT.
Add 6 µL Beta-mercaptoethanol.

steps.title: Homogenization and Clarification
steps.instruction: Homogenize the sample using a Qiashredder column and clarify the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Pipette mixture into Qiashredder column and spin for 00:02:00 @ 8,000rpm.
Remove Qiashredder column, add cap, and spin for 00:03:00 @ max speed.

steps.title: RNA Binding and Washing
steps.instruction: Bind the RNA to an RNeasy column and perform initial washes.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL 70% Ethanol to a new collection tube.
Transfer lysate to the collection tube and mix with 70% Ethanol by pipetting.
Transfer lysate to RNeasy column (700 µL at a time), spinning each aliquot for 00:00:15 @ 9,800rpm and discarding flow through.
Add 700 µL Buffer RWI and spin for 00:00:15 @ 9,800rpm.
Transfer RNeasy column to a new collection tube.

steps.title: Column Washing and Drying
steps.instruction: Wash the RNeasy column with Buffer RPE and dry the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer RPE, spin for 00:00:15 @ 9,800rpm, and discard flow through.
Add 500 µL Buffer RPE, spin for 00:01:00 @ 9,800rpm, and discard flow through.
Spin for 00:02:00 @ 13,000rpm to dry the column.
Transfer RNeasy column to a new collection tube.

steps.title: RNA Elution and Standardization
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA and standardize the concentration.

substeps.instruction: Elute with 30 µL RNAse-Free H2O and spin for 00:01:00 @ 13,000rpm.
Repeat elution with another 30 µL RNAse-Free H2O and spin for 00:01:00 @ 13,000rpm.
Combine mRNA and RNAse-free H2O to standardize all samples to aliquots containing 0.4 µg mRNA total in 10 µL.

steps.title: First-Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription using Master Mix 1 and Master Mix 2.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 3 µL of Master Mix 1 (containing 1 µL dNTP mix and 2 µL dT primer per sample) into each sample.
Place sample on dry bath at 65 °C for 00:05:00.
Place samples on ice for 00:01:00.
Pipette 6.5 µL of Master Mix 2 (containing 4 µL Buffer, 2 µL DTT and 0.5 µL RNAase inhibitor per sample) into each sample.
Pipette 1 µL Superscript into each sample.
Incubate samples at room temperature for 00:10:00.
Incubate samples at 42 °C for 00:50:00.

steps.title: PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Prepare a PCR master mix and amplify the target sequence.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a master mix per sample containing: 2.0 µL 10X Buffer, 1.0 µL 50 mM MgSO4, 0.5 µL dNTP mix (10 µM each), 18.4 µL ddH2O, 1 µL forward primer (10 µM), 1 µL reverse primer (10 µM), and 0.5 µL Taq polymerase.
Mix well by spinning.
Add 24 µL of Master Mix to each PCR tube.
Add 1 µL of sample for a total volume of 25 µL per tube.
